Messages.Author: Brian Kallenbach
Messages.Body:
Daniel Hoffman wrote:
>
> This card says you can tap it for an extra master phase, does this mean you
> can use blood dolls twice, place two temptation counters, get 4 master card
> plays with Rumors of Ghenna etc. or does it mean you can do 1 addition master
> card play?

It's not another Master Phase, it's another Master Phase *Action*. Cards such as
Protracted Investment or others which say "To something as your Master Phase Action" can
be done multiple times, but Blood Doll can be done only once.

Messages.Author: Nicole Roy
Messages.Body:
Bradley Kellogg (br...@rahul.net) wrote:

: Can I use Anson, a Rumors of Gehenna and the Pathenon to get four Master
: actions?

No - but you can get up to three master-phase actions. Anson and Rumors
both state (In the Jyhad versions, anyway) that they give you two
master-phase actions, not +1 action. Playing either of these in
conjunction with the other still only gives you 2 actions.

Playing either of them in conjunction with the PArthenon, however, will
allow you to get up to three, as the parthenon specifically says 'an
additional master phase action' rather than a specific number.

Shane, not Nicole.
